svg.title: Pig farmer — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as pig farmer, wearing coveralls and a peaked work cap. Visible work cue: A pig has pointed ears and an open oval snout above a separate feed rail. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a peaked work cap.
